note: The suite disc psm-suite-s4b: demo/psm/suite/build.py --tag s4b --list demo/psm/suite/suite_s4b.json. A short menu: ao4 (the split-screen AO demo on simple scenes), Junior's three hud1c builds (the bisect of hud1b's hang at frame 1), and Junior's ao1c and ao1c-live (the town's AO demo with a CLAY view on Y). s4 was the same with s3's ao1 in their place; it is superseded. RUN ALL runs ao4 alone: a hud1c build may hang by design. Dropped from s3: c4g, r3-d, qr-q2, ao0 (their results are in), the town v1 builds a3e-auto, a3f-auto, bake1-auto, hud1b-auto, and a3e-t2 / a3e-poll. Times are ESTIMATE, not measured.

tests.name: ao4
tests.what: AO side by side: spheres, a corner. ~40 s
tests.read: watch it; photo page and graph; START = live, X Y A B

tests.name: ao1c
tests.what: town AO autorun as s3, then Y = CLAY view. ~1 min
tests.read: pages as on s3; then live: Y CLAY, X AO OFF/1/2

tests.name: ao1c-live
tests.what: town free walk: X AO OFF/1/2, Y CLAY/TEXTURED
tests.read: photo pairs at one spot: CLAY, AO OFF/1/2; then TEXTURED

tests.name: hud1c-1
tests.what: hud1b with the ASIC error events off
tests.read: photo the bottom two lines; ABXY or START 3 s leaves

tests.name: hud1c-2
tests.what: hud1b with no DIAG box in the opaque list
tests.read: photo the bottom two lines; ABXY or START 3 s leaves

tests.name: hud1c-3
tests.what: hud1b with no 64 KB DIAG texture
tests.read: photo the bottom two lines; ABXY or START 3 s leaves
